messages:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — Nimbus joint-POC kickoff tomorrow. Need a quick tech + pricing handoff so sales can finalize SOW. Short checklist: infra option, security Q, success criteria, sample prompts.
Maria Lopez: Thanks. Partner asked for VPC peering + SAML SSO. Is that doable for a 60-day co-sell POC?
Samir Patel: Yes we can do SAML + VPC peering on Private deployment. Need expected qps and sample payload sizes. Also, will they want int8 quant?
Rajesh Nair: Two feasible infra paths: (1) Hosted with VPC peering and limited isolation, faster to stand up; (2) Dedicated reserved pool in their org / partner account for full isolation and predictable perf. Which does sales prefer?
Ethan (Sales): Partner wants 60d POC, ~2 GPUs (A100), ~1k reqs/day, burst to 200 rps during demo. They asked if we offer a co-sell discount on committed POC capacity.
Alex Kim: Typical co-sell POC terms: trial credits + partner discount. For Dedicated POC we can offer ~25% off for 90 days if MOU signed. I'll confirm with partnerships legal.
Claire - PartnerEng: They'll need redacted compliance docs (SOC2 summary, encryption at rest/in transit) and KMS integration notes. I'll need to fill their security questionnaire once we get it.
sec-bot: Security artifacts: https://redwood.corp/internal/sec/redacted-soc2-v2.pdf (redacted), encryption/KMS notes: https://redwood.corp/internal/sec/kms-integration.md
Samir Patel: For SAML we require name, email, groups attributes. Also we need to know whether users will be routed through partner IdP or our SSO proxy.
Maria Lopez: Partner will send the security questionnaire PDF by EOD. Who is owning responses?
Rajesh Nair: I'll own the technical sections. @Samir Patel can you export runtime image SHAs and compose the asset inventory? Need those for the SQ.
Samir Patel: On it. I'll post container image SHAs and a short deploy guide. Also confirming int8 support: we have int8 inference path on A100 with our kernel set but need perf validation for their model family.
Alex Kim: Noted — please flag any quality regressions during quant validation. Claire, can we offer a short enablement workshop the week of 4/1? Partner asked for a 90-minute deep dive + sample prompts.
Claire - PartnerEng: Yes, I can run it. I'll prepare a deck + walkthrough and a notebook with sample prompt pairs. Need contact list and PRDs.
Ethan (Sales): Timeline: demo (partner-facing) 2026-03-30, POC start 2026-04-07, SOW ready by 2026-04-02. Sales needs SLA/penalty language rough draft to include in SOW. Can eng commit to infra start 2026-04-05?
Rajesh Nair: We can commit to infra provisioning 4/5 assuming Legal returns the MOU by 4/1. Risk: Dedicated GPU quota may require 48h to provision; Hosted path is faster.
Samir Patel: Work items for me: export images + SHAs, run int8 sanity on sample model, produce simple deploy snippet.
Samir Patel: ```
# sample nginx front for streaming API
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_pass http://inference:8080;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
  proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
}
```
Maria Lopez: I've uploaded the draft architecture and checklist to Confluence: https://redwood.corp/display/POC/Nimbus-co-sell-arch (private).
Ethan (Sales): Quick pricing Q: if they convert to Dedicated after POC, can partner get resale margin? Need to confirm channel pricing and enablement credits.
Alex Kim: Partnerships will handle commercial terms. I'll loop in Sarah from Partner Ops after this thread.
Claire - PartnerEng: For the enablement, please send sample prompts and 3 success criteria (latency < 250ms p50, ingestion accuracy > 92% on eval set, 99.9% availability during demo).
Rajesh Nair: Ack. Adding those to the checklist.
Maria Lopez: Who's on the readiness call tomorrow 10:00am PT?
Alex Kim: I'll chair. @Maria Lopez, @Rajesh Nair, @Samir Patel, @Claire - PartnerEng, @Ethan (Sales) — please join.
Maria Lopez: I'll be there.
Samir Patel: I'll be there — will bring the image SHAs.
Rajesh Nair: On calendar.
Claire - PartnerEng: In. I'll bring the deck.
Ethan (Sales): On it.
deploy-bot: demo-staging environment deployed at https://staging.redwood.corp/nimbus-poc — staging creds sent to partners via secure link.
Alex Kim: Great work team. I'll draft MOU + partner intro email and post updates here. :thumbsup:
